muyesser-irab:18-18.t: ﴿وبالأسحار هم يستغفرون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; وبالأسحار: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يستغفرون﴾, and the bāʾ has the meaning of «في» (in); هم is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause يستغفرون is the khabar (predicate). What is attached to the khabar was placed first because it is permissible to place the governing word (al-ʿāmil) first.

muyesser-irab:19-19.t: ﴿وفي أموالهم حق للسائل والمحروم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; وفي أموالهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); حق is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); وللسائل: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective); والمحروم is conjoined to السائل. The clause is conjoined to the khabar of kāna, so it is a third khabar.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t: ﴿وفي الأرض آيات للموقنين﴾: the wāw is conjunctive, or resumptive; وفي الأرض is a fronted khabar (predicate); وآيات is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); وللموقنين is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿آيات﴾. The clause ﴿وفي الأرض...﴾ is conjoined, or resumptive with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t: ﴿وفي أنفسكم أفلا تبصرون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; وفي أنفسكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) whose mubtadaʾ (subject) has been omitted, the implied form being: آيات (signs). The hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval (al-istifhām al-inkārī); the fāʾ is conjunctive, conjoining to an omitted, implied clause; لا is negating; and تبصرون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).

muyesser-irab:22-22.t: ﴿وفي السماء رزقكم وما توعدون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive. وفي السماء: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate). ورزقكم is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject). The wāw is conjunctive. ﴿ما﴾ is a relative noun conjoined to ﴿رزقكم﴾, nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿توعدون﴾ is an imperfect verb, passive (built for the one whose agent is not named). The wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The clause ﴿توعدون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The returning pronoun (al-ʿāʾid) is omitted.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t: ﴿فورب السماء والأرض إنه لحق مثل ما أنكم تنطقون﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive. The wāw: a particle of oath and of the genitive. ﴿رب﴾ is genitive (majrūr) by the wāw. The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being: أقسم (I swear). ﴿السماء﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, and the sign of the genitive is the kasra. ﴿الأرض﴾ is conjoined to السماء. ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun. The lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and ﴿حق﴾ is its khabar (predicate). ﴿مثل﴾ is indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿حق﴾; the reason for its indeclinability is that it is annexed to an indeclinable word. ﴿ما﴾ is an indefinite noun that is qualified (nakira mawṣūfa), in the position of the genitive by annexation to مثل. ﴿أن﴾ is an abrogating particle. ﴿كم﴾ is the noun of inna. The clause ﴿تنطقون﴾ is its khabar. The clause ﴿أنكم﴾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation; or ﴿ما﴾ is a qualified indefinite noun and the clause is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: هو أنكم (it is that you…).

muyesser-irab:24-24.t: ﴿هل أتاك حديث ضيف إبراهيم المكرمين﴾: هل is an interrogative particle; أتاك is a verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ضيف إبراهيم is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and المكرمين is a naʿt (adjective) of ضيف. [Translator's note: the source does not parse حديث, the fāʿil (agent) of أتاك; ضيف is the muḍāf ilayhi of حديث, and إبراهيم the muḍāf ilayhi of ضيف.]

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿إذ﴾: an adverb (ẓarf) for past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حديث﴾ or to ﴿المكرمين﴾ in the previous ayah.
﴿دخلوا﴾: a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿دخلوا﴾ is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it.
﴿عليه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿دخلوا﴾.
﴿فقالوا﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, and قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil; the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿دخلوا﴾.
﴿سلامًا﴾: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: نسلِّم سلاما (we greet with a greeting of peace).
﴿قال﴾: a past verb, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: هو (he).
﴿سلام﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject); it was permissible to begin with it although it is indefinite because it carries the meaning of a supplication; the khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being: سلام عليكم (peace be upon you).
﴿قوم﴾: the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being: وأنتم (and you are), or هم (they are).
﴿منكرون﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of قوم.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t: ﴿فراغ إلى أهله فجاء بعجل سمين﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, conjoining to an implied clause that the context requires, i.e.: so he hastened to honour them without letting them notice; راغ is a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); وإلى أهله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) راغ; فجاء is conjoined, expressing immediate sequence (al-taʿqīb); وبعجل: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to جاء; and سمين is a naʿt (adjective) of عجل.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t: ﴿فقربه إليهم قال ألا تأكلون﴾: conjoined to what preceded; وإليهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) قربه; ألا is an interrogative particle [Translator's note: i.e. its hamza], and لا is negating, and the interrogative is for offering (al-ʿarḍ) or for disapproval (al-inkār); تأكلون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying).

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿فأوجس منهم خيفة﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, conjoining to an implied clause that the context requires; أوجس is a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being هو (he); and خيفة is the object (mafʿūl) of أوجس.
﴿قالوا لا تخف وبشروه بغلام عليم﴾: لا is the prohibitive lā, and تخف is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾; بشروه is a past verb, a fāʿil, and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); وبغلام: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿بشروه﴾; and عليم is a naʿt (adjective) of غلام.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t: ﴿فأقبلت امرأته في صرة فصكت وجهها وقالت عجوز عقيم﴾: also conjoined to an implied clause that cannot be done without; امرأته is the fāʿil (agent) of فأقبلت; وفي صرة: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); فصكت is conjoined to ﴿فأقبلت﴾; ووجهها is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); وقالت is also conjoined; عجوز is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. أنا عجوز (I am an old woman); and عقيم is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:30-30.t: ﴿قالوا كذلك قال ربك إنه هو الحكيم العليم﴾: قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ﴿كذلك﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning مثل (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: a saying like that which we said; ﴿ذلك﴾: ﴿ذا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the lām is for distance, and the kāf is a particle of address; ﴿قال ربك﴾ is a verb and its fāʿil; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun; هو is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position; الحكيم is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and العليم is a second khabar of inna.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t: ﴿قال فما خطبكم أيها المرسلون﴾: قال is a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), i.e. Ibrāhīm; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted clause); ما is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject); خطبكم is the khabar (predicate); ﴿أي﴾ is the one addressed (munādā) from which the vocative particle has been omitted, and it is indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma because it is a specifically intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda); ها is for alerting (al-tanbīh); and المرسلون is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t: ﴿قالوا إنا أرسلنا إلى قوم مجرمين﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; أرسل is a past verb, passive (built for the one whose agent is not named), and نا is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause أرسلنا is the khabar (predicate) of inna, and inna together with what falls in its scope is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying); وإلى قوم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أرسلنا﴾; and مجرمين is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:33-33.t: ﴿لنرسل عليهم حجارة من طين﴾: the lām is for causation (al-taʿlīl); نرسل is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit أن after the lām of causation, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: نحن (we); وعليهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) نرسل; حجارة is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); من طين is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿حجارة﴾; and the lām of causation together with what it governs is attached to ﴿أرسلنا﴾.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t: ﴿مسومة عند ربك للمسرفين﴾: مسومة is a second naʿt (adjective) of حجارة, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from it, because it has been qualified by the preposition and its genitive noun; عند ربك: the adverb (ẓarf) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مسومة﴾; and وللمسرفين: a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to ﴿مسومة﴾.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t: ﴿فأخرجنا من كان فيها من المؤمنين﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa, because it discloses clauses that have been omitted; أخرجنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); من is an object (mafʿūl); كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and its noun is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: هم (they); فيها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of kāna; من المؤمنين is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause of kāna is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The pronoun in His words فيها refers back to the towns of the people of Lūṭ.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t: ﴿فما وجدنا فيها غير بيت من المسلمين﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; ما is negating; وجدنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); غير بيت is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and من المسلمين is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:37-37.t: ﴿وتركنا فيها آية للذين يخافون العذاب الأليم﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; تركنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); وفيها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تركنا﴾; آية is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); للذين is a naʿt (adjective) of آية; and the clause ﴿يخافون العذاب الأليم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t: ﴿وفي موسى إذ أرسلناه إلى فرعون بسلطان مبين﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿في موسى﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, conjoined to ﴿فيها﴾ in the words of Allah the Exalted ﴿وتركنا فيها آية﴾ with the preposition repeated, so the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تركنا﴾ in terms of meaning, and the implied form is: and We left in the story of Mūsā a sign; ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) for past time, attached to ﴿تركنا﴾; the clause ﴿أرسلناه﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿إلى فرعون﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أرسلنا﴾; ﴿بسلطان﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: مؤيّدًا (supported); and ﴿مبين﴾ is a naʿt (adjective).

muyesser-irab:39-39.t: ﴿فتولى بركنه وقال ساحر أو مجنون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; تولى is a past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), referring back to Firʿawn; بركنه is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun of Firʿawn; قال is conjoined to تولى; ساحر is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: هو ساحر (he is a sorcerer); أو is a conjunction for leaving the matter vague to the listener (al-ibhām), or for doubt; and مجنون is conjoined to ساحر.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t: ﴿فأخذناه وجنوده فنبذناهم في اليم وهو مليم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; أخذناه is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); جنوده is conjoined to the object of أخذناه, and it has been said: it is a mafʿūl maʿahu (object of accompaniment). فنبذناهم في اليم is conjoined to أخذناه; وفي اليم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) نبذناه [Translator's note: so in the source; the word in the ayah is نبذناهم]. وهو: the wāw is circumstantial (of the ḥāl), and هو is a detached pronoun in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject); مليم is the khabar (predicate); and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of نبذناهم, or from the object of أخذناه.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t: ﴿وفي عاد إذ أرسلنا عليهم الريح العقيم﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿في عاد﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, conjoined to ﴿فيها﴾ in the words of Allah the Exalted ﴿وتركنا فيها آية﴾ with the preposition repeated, so the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تركنا﴾ in terms of meaning, and the implied form is: and We left in the story of ʿĀd a sign; ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) for past time, attached to ﴿تركنا﴾; the clause ﴿أرسلنا﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أرسلنا﴾; ﴿الريح﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and ﴿العقيم﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of الريح.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t: ﴿ما تذر من شيء أتت عليه إلا جعلته كالرميم﴾: ما is negating; تذر is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: هي (it), i.e. the wind; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الريح; من is a redundant (ṣila) preposition, and شيء is genitive in form and accusative in position because it is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause أتت عليه is a naʿt (adjective) of شيء; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); جعلته is a verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi, and the clause stands in the place of the second object of ﴿تذر﴾, as if it were said: it leaves nothing except made (into…); ﴿كالرميم﴾: the kāf is a noun meaning مثل (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as the second object of ﴿جعلته﴾, and ﴿الرميم﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

muyesser-irab:43-43.t: ﴿وفي ثمود إذ قيل لهم تمتعوا حتى حين﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ﴿في ثمود﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, conjoined to ﴿فيها﴾ in the words of Allah the Exalted ﴿وتركنا فيها آية﴾ with the preposition repeated, so the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تركنا﴾ in terms of meaning, and the implied form is: and We left in the story of Thamūd a sign; ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf) for past time, attached to ﴿تركنا﴾; the clause ﴿قيل﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿تمتعوا﴾ is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the verb of saying); ﴿حتى﴾ is a particle of limit (ghāya) and of the genitive; ﴿حين﴾ is genitive (majrūr) by حتى; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿تمتعوا﴾.

muyesser-irab:44-44.t: ﴿فعتوا عن أمر ربهم فأخذتهم الصاعقة وهم ينظرون﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction for sequence in the narration (al-tartīb al-ikhbārī); عتوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); عن أمر ربهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عتوا﴾; فأخذتهم الصاعقة is conjoined to عتوا; the wāw is circumstantial (of the ḥāl); هم is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ينظرون is the khabar (predicate); and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:45-45.t: ﴿فما استطاعوا من قيام وما كانوا منتصرين﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive; ما is negating; استطاعوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); من is a redundant (ṣila) preposition, and قيام is genitive in form and accusative in position because it is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the wāw is conjunctive; ما is negating; كانوا is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the wāw is its noun; and منتصرين is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:46-46.t: ﴿وقوم نوح من قبل إنهم كانوا قوما فاسقين﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; قوم is accusative (manṣūb) by an omitted verb understood implicitly, i.e.: and We destroyed the people of Nūḥ, and you may also take its implied form to be: and remember the people of Nūḥ; ومن قبل: من is a preposition, and قبل is an adverb (ẓarf), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation in wording but not in meaning; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿هم﴾ is its noun; the clause كانوا قومًا فاسقين is its khabar (predicate); and the clause of inna with what follows it has no grammatical position, because it gives the reason for their destruction.

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿والسماء بنيناها بأيد﴾: the wāw is resumptive. والسماء: accusative by al-ishtighāl (the verb being occupied with a pronoun of the noun), the implied form being: بنينا السماء بنيناها (We built the heaven; We built it). بنيناها: a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause ﴿بنيناها﴾ is explicative, with no grammatical position. The clause بنينا السماء is conjoined to the preceding verbal clause. وبأيد: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of بنيناها, i.e. endowed with strength, or from its object, i.e. endowed with strength; or they are attached to ﴿بنيناها﴾, in which case the bāʾ is causal, i.e.: because of Our power. The clause ﴿والسماء بنيناها بأيد﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وإنا لموسعون﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); موسعون is its khabar (predicate); and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the fāʿil of بنيناها, or from its object.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t: ﴿والأرض فرشناها فنعم الماهدون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; والأرض: accusative by al-ishtighāl (the verb being occupied with a pronoun of the noun), the implied form being: فرشنا الأرض فرشناها (We spread the earth; We spread it); فرشناها: a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿فرشناها﴾ is explicative, with no grammatical position; the fāʾ is conjunctive; نعم: an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing praise; الماهدون: the fāʿil of نعم; and the one specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-madḥ) is omitted, i.e.: نحن (We), and the clause is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:49-49.t: ﴿ومن كل شيء خلقنا زوجين لعلكم تذكرون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ومن كل شيء is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خلقنا﴾, i.e.: We created of every thing two pairs; or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from زوجين, because it is originally a naʿt (adjective) of it, the implied form being: We created two pairs being of every thing; خلقنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); زوجين is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); لعل is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) expressing hope; ﴿كم﴾ is its noun; and the clause تذكرون is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿ففروا إلى الله﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted clause), and an omitted muḍāf must be implied, i.e.: to His reward; فروا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); وإلى الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿فروا﴾.
﴿إني لكم منه نذير مبين﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the yāʾ is its noun; ولكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نذير﴾, and منه is likewise attached; you may also attach it to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from نذير, because it is originally a naʿt (adjective) of it; نذير is the khabar (predicate) of إني; and مبين is a naʿt of نذير.

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿ولا تجعلوا مع الله إلها آخر﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; لا is the prohibitive lā; تجعلوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); مع الله is an adverb (ẓarf) of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) something omitted standing in the place of the second object; إلهًا: the first object (mafʿūl) of تجعلوا; and آخر is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿إلهًا﴾.
﴿إني لكم منه نذير مبين﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the yāʾ is its noun; ولكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿نذير﴾, and منه is likewise attached; you may also attach it to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from نذير, because it is originally a naʿt of it; نذير is the khabar (predicate) of إني; and مبين is a naʿt of نذير. This clause is repeated for emphasis: the first is tied to the abandonment of faith and obedience, and the second is tied to associating partners (al-ishrāk).

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿كذلك ما أتى الذين من قبلهم﴾: كذلك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: the matter and the affair (is like that). ما is negating. أتى is a past verb. الذين is its fronted object (mafʿūl). ومن قبلهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to something omitted that is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿من رسول﴾: من: a redundant (ṣila) preposition. رسول is genitive by من in form and nominative in position, because it is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿إلا قالوا ساحر أو مجنون﴾: إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). قالوا is a verb and its fāʿil. ساحر is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being: أنت (you are); أو is a conjunction; and مجنون is conjoined to ساحر; the meaning of the conjunction has been discussed before. The clause إلا قالوا is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الذين من قبلهم, as if it were said: no messenger came to those before them except in the state of their saying: he is a sorcerer or a madman. The clause ﴿كذلك ما أتى...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:53-53.t: ﴿أتواصوا به بل هم قوم طاغون﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disapproval, rebuke and amazement; تواصوا is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), the wāw being the fāʿil of تواصوا; وبه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تواصوا﴾; بل is a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction; هم is a mubtadaʾ (subject); قوم is the khabar (predicate); and طاغون is a naʿt (adjective) of قوم.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t: ﴿فتول عنهم فما أنت بملوم﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted clause); فتول: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: أنت (you); وعنهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تول﴾; ﴿فما﴾: the fāʾ gives the reason for the command, and ﴿ما﴾ is the Ḥijāzī negating mā that operates like laysa; ﴿أنت﴾ is the noun of mā; ﴿بملوم﴾: the bāʾ is a redundant (ṣila) preposition, and ﴿ملوم﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position and genitive by the bāʾ in form.

muyesser-irab:55-55.t: ﴿وذكر فإن الذكرى تنفع المؤمنين﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ذكر is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: أنت (you); the fāʾ gives the reason for the command; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); الذكرى is its noun; and the clause تنفع المؤمنين is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:56-56.t: ﴿وما خلقت الجن والإنس إلا ليعبدون﴾: the wāw is conjunctive; ما is negating; خلقت is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); الجن is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الإنس is conjoined to الجن; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); the lām is for causation (al-taʿlīl), or for consequence (al-ʿāqiba); يعبدون is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit أن after the lām of causation, and the sign of its accusative is the dropping of the nūn; the nūn that appears is the nūn of protection (al-wiqāya); the wāw is the fāʿil; the omitted first-person yāʾ is in the position of the accusative as a mafʿūl bihi; and the lām of causation together with what it governs is attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خلقت﴾.

muyesser-irab:57-57.t: ﴿ما أريد منهم من رزق وما أريد أن يطعمون﴾: ما is negating; أريد is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being: أنا (I); ومنهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أريد﴾; من is a redundant (ṣila) preposition, and رزق is genitive in form and accusative in position because it is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿أريد﴾; the wāw is a conjunction, and ما أريد is conjoined to its counterpart; أن is a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; ويطمعون [Translator's note: so in the source; the word in the ayah is يطعمون] is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن; the omitted first-person yāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi; and أن with what falls in its scope is construed as an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) serving as a mafʿūl bihi, i.e.: and I do not want their feeding Me.

muyesser-irab:58-58.t: ﴿إن الله هو الرزاق ذو القوة المتين﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; هو is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position; الرزاق is the first khabar (predicate) of inna; ذو القوة is a second khabar; and المتين is a third khabar; and it has been said: it is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿الرزاق﴾ or of ﴿ذو﴾.

muyesser-irab:59-59.t: ﴿فإن للذين ظلموا ذنوبا مثل ذنوب أصحابهم فلا يستعجلون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an omitted clause); إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); وللذين is a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of the accusative as the fronted khabar (predicate) of inna; the clause ظلموا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ذنوبًا is the postponed noun of inna; مثل ذنوب أصحابهم is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿ذنوبًا﴾; the fāʾ is conjunctive, ordering the prohibition of seeking to hasten; لا is the prohibitive lā; يستعجلون is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, and the sign of its jussive is the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the nūn that appears, with kasra, is for protection (al-wiqāya); and the omitted yāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:60-60.t: ﴿فويل للذين كفروا من يومهم الذي يوعدون﴾: the fāʾ is conjunctive, ordering the establishment of woe for them; ويل is a mubtadaʾ (subject); it was permissible to begin with it because of the meaning of supplication it carries; وللذين is its khabar (predicate); the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. ومن يومهم is a naʿt (adjective) of ويل, and it has been said that it [Translator's note: i.e. من] has the meaning of «في» (in); الذي is a naʿt of يومهم; يوعدون is an imperfect verb, passive (built for the one whose agent is not named), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the clause يوعدون is the ṣila of الذي, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿والذاريات﴾: the wāw is a particle of oath and of the genitive; الذاريات: genitive (majrūr) by the wāw of the oath; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being أقسم ("I swear").
﴿ذروًا﴾: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), the governing word being the active participle; the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) is omitted.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t: ﴿قتل الخراصون﴾: the clause is one of supplication (duʿāʾiyya), with no grammatical position; قتل: a passive past verb (built for an unnamed agent); الخراصون: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:11-11.t: ﴿الذين هم في غمرة ساهون﴾: الذين: an adjective of الخراصون; هم: mubtadaʾ (subject); في غمرة: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ساهون﴾; ساهون: the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هم﴾; the clause ﴿هم في غمرة ساهون﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause).

muyesser-irab:12-12.t: ﴿يسألون أيان يوم الدين﴾: يسألون: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); أيان: an interrogative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as an adverb of time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); يوم الدين: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause is in the position of accusative as the object of يسألون.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t: ﴿يوم هم على النار يفتنون﴾: يوم: a mafʿūl fīhi (adverbial), an adverb of time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being يقع ("it occurs") or يجيء ("it comes"); هم: mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يفتنون is its khabar (predicate); على النار: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يفتنون﴾, على having the sense of في; the clause is in the position of genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of يوم to it.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t: ﴿ذوقوا فتنتكم هذا الذي كنتم به تستعجلون﴾: the clause is the object of an omitted saying, i.e. "and it will be said to them at the time of the punishment: ذوقوا ('taste')". ذوقوا: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); كان: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; the tāʾ is its noun; به: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تستعجلون﴾; the clause تستعجلون is the khabar (predicate) of كان.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t: ﴿إن المتقين في جنات وعيون﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); المتقين: its noun; في جنات: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of إن; عيون is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to جنات.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿آخذين ما آتاهم ربهم﴾: آخذين: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun concealed (mustakinn) in the khabar (predicate) of إن, i.e. "they have settled, content with what He gave them and delighted with it"; ما: a relative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of آخذين; the clause ﴿آتاهم ربهم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position.
﴿إنهم كانوا قبل ذلك محسنين﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ﴿هم﴾: its noun; the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is its khabar; the clause ﴿إنهم كانوا﴾ gives the reason for what was mentioned; قبل ذلك: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) محسنين; محسنين: the khabar of كانوا.

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿كانوا﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; the wāw of the group is its noun.
﴿قليلا﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted adverb of time, i.e. "a little time"; or: standing in for an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "they used to sleep at night a little sleep".
﴿من الليل﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of ﴿قليلا﴾.
﴿ما﴾: a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) particle.
﴿يهجعون﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause يهجعون is the khabar (predicate) of كان. The clause ﴿كانوا قليلا من الليل ما يهجعون﴾ is in the position of nominative as a badal (substitute) from the clause ﴿كانوا قبل ذلك محسنين﴾, a badal of part from whole. Or it is an explicative clause, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t: ﴿فالحاملات وقرا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction particle; الحاملات is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to الذاريات; وقرًا: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the active participle.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿فالجاريات﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction particle; الجاريات is also conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it.
﴿يسرا﴾: a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "with ease" or "made easy"; or: standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) because it is an adjective of the maṣdar, i.e. "an easy running".

muyesser-irab:4-4.t: ﴿فالمقسمات أمرا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; المقسمات is also conjoined (maʿṭūf); أمرًا: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the active participle.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t: ﴿إنما توعدون لصادق﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of accusative (manṣūb) as the noun of ﴿إن﴾. The clause ﴿توعدون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position, and the referring pronoun (ʿāʾid) is omitted, i.e. توعدونه ("which you are promised"). The lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa). صادق: the khabar (predicate) of إن. Or ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and the interpreted maṣdar from the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾ with what follows it is in the position of accusative as the noun of ﴿إن﴾, i.e. "your being promised is true". The clause ﴿توعدون﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdariyya ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿إنما توعدون لصادق﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the answer to the oath.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t: ﴿وإن الدين لواقع﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is for emphasis and the accusative; الدين: its noun, accusative (manṣūb); لواقع: the lām is the shifted lām (muzaḥlaqa), and واقع is the khabar (predicate) of إن; the clause إن الدين لواقع is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to إن ما توعدون لصادق.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t: ﴿والسماء ذات الحبك﴾: the wāw is a particle of oath and of the genitive; السماء: genitive (majrūr) by the wāw of the oath; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being أقسم ("I swear"). ذات: a naʿt (adjective) of السماء. الحبك: muḍāf ilayhi. The clause of the oath is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t: ﴿إنكم لفي قول مختلف﴾: إن: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); ﴿كم﴾: its noun; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); في قول: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of إن; مختلف: a naʿt (adjective) of قول. The clause ﴿إنكم لفي قول مختلف﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the answer to the oath.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t: ﴿يؤفك عنه من أفك﴾: the pronoun refers to the Qurʾān or to the Messenger; يؤفك: a passive imperfect verb (built for an unnamed agent); عنه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يؤفك﴾; من: a relative noun in the position of nominative (marfūʿ) as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); أفك: a passive past verb, its nāʾib fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "he"; the clause ﴿أُفِكَ﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause); the clause ﴿يؤفك﴾ is in the position of genitive (majrūr) as a second naʿt (adjective) of قول.
